I'm sorry, that's worrying. Please reset your password right away so the other person is locked out. Because this may be unauthorized access and a possible fraudulent charge, I'm escalating this to a Support Lead, who will follow up on the order and any charge.

To help them, please send me the order number (it looks like LF-123456) if you have it. Please don't share your password or full card number. If you want to try stopping the order, note that it can only be changed or cancelled free within 2 hours of ordering from "My Orders". After that, support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed, and shipped orders can't be cancelled.
